components.name: Accordion
components.description: Contract — src/components/Accordion/Accordion.tsx: Accordion.Root with three exposed Accordion.Item instances, as in the Default story at 480px (none open). Open an item on its instance; coming back, the open items' values are the Root's defaultValue (multiple allows more than one).

components.name: Accordion.Item
components.description: Contract — src/components/Accordion/Accordion.tsx: Accordion.Item > Accordion.Header > Accordion.Trigger, then Accordion.Panel. open: false | true — Base UI state: the item whose value is in the Root's value/defaultValue; turns the chevron 180°. disabled: false | true (an Item prop; the Root's disabled cascades). trigger → Accordion.Trigger (text). panel → Accordion.Panel (text). The chevron (icon/chevron-down-accordion) is drawn by the component.

props.name: panel
props.default: Plans are billed monthly on the day you subscribed. Changing plan mid-cycle prorates the difference on your next invoice.

components.name: Alert
components.description:
An inline message block. No Base UI primitive to wrap; the job is semantics.
Contract — src/components/Alert/Alert.tsx: variant (info | success | warning | danger, default info), title (the headline, required), children (the body copy), onDismiss (in code, passing it renders the dismiss button). Width is Fill container on the instance.

props.name: children
props.default: Exports are paused on Sunday from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC.

components.name: AlertDialog.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/AlertDialog/AlertDialog.tsx: AlertDialog.Content — portal, backdrop and popup, centred on the viewport — as in the Default story. title: text, required (heading-xl). description → AlertDialog.Description (text). AlertDialog.Actions: the button row, end-aligned; its Buttons are exposed (AlertDialog.Close renders them). Width: min(26rem, 100vw − space/8).

props.name: description
props.default: Your changes since the last save will be lost.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.description: Contract — src/components/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.tsx: Autocomplete, a text input with suggestions, wired to a label, description and validation message, as in the stories at 320px. Unlike Combobox, any text is kept as the value. label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default). filled, open, disabled, clearable, showTrigger: on the exposed Autocomplete.Control. Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid border.

props.name: description
props.default: Suggestions are hints. Any text you type is kept as the value.

components.name: Autocomplete.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.tsx: Autocomplete.Content — portal, positioner, popup and list — with the first languages of the stories' list. Input-wide (--anchor-width, runtime; 320px here), below, aligned to the start, 4px away. The suggestions are exposed Autocomplete.Item instances. Autocomplete.Empty shows when nothing matches (NoSuggestions story).

components.name: Autocomplete.Control
components.description: Contract — src/components/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.tsx: Autocomplete.Control — the input with its clear and trigger buttons. filled: false | true — Base UI Field state: the placeholder, or a value. open: false | true — flips the chevron. disabled: false | true. clearable (default true): the clear button, shown on the filled variants. showTrigger (default false, unlike Combobox): the chevron button (WithTriggerButton story). placeholder and value: their texts.

components.name: Autocomplete.Item
components.description: Contract — src/components/Autocomplete/Autocomplete.tsx: Autocomplete.Item, one suggestion. highlighted: false | true — Base UI state, the suggestion under the pointer or keyboard. disabled: false | true. children: its text. No indicator and no selected state: a suggestion fills the input, it does not become a value.

components.name: Avatar
components.description:
A person’s picture, or their initials. Wraps Base UI’s Avatar.
Contract — src/components/Avatar/Avatar.tsx: size (sm | md | lg, default md), fallback (the initials). src is not mirrored, so Figma always shows the fallback.

components.name: Badge
components.description:
A small status or counter label. Non-interactive, so it renders a plain <span>; no Base UI primitive to wrap.
Contract — src/components/Badge/Badge.tsx: variant (neutral | accent | success | warning | danger, default neutral), size (sm | md, default md), children (the text). Property and value names are the code’s own.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description:
Where the current page sits in the hierarchy.
Contract — src/components/Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.tsx: Breadcrumb.Root (aria-label, default "Breadcrumb") holding Breadcrumb.Item parts: Link, Separator, Current. The Link and Current instances are exposed, so their labels are editable here; hide a Link and its Separator for a shorter trail.

components.name: Breadcrumb.Current
components.description:
The page you are on. Rendered as <span aria-current="page">.
Contract — src/components/Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.tsx: Breadcrumb.Current, children (the label).

components.name: Breadcrumb.Link
components.description:
An ancestor page in the trail. Rendered as <a>.
Contract — src/components/Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.tsx: Breadcrumb.Link, children (the label), href. Hover colour and underline are CSS states.

components.name: Breadcrumb.Separator
components.description:
The chevron between items. Hidden from assistive tech.
Contract — src/components/Breadcrumb/Breadcrumb.tsx: Breadcrumb.Separator.

components.name: Button
components.description:
The primary action trigger. Built on Base UI’s unstyled Button, styled entirely with semantic design tokens.
Contract — src/components/Button/Button.tsx: variant (primary | secondary | ghost | danger, default primary), size (sm | md | lg, default md), disabled (false | true, Base UI), children (the label). fullWidth maps to Fill container on the instance; hover and active are CSS states, not props.

components.name: Card
components.description:
A surface container. Purely presentational, so no Base UI primitive to wrap.
Contract — src/components/Card/Card.tsx: variant (outlined | elevated, default outlined). The code parts map to boolean properties named after them: Card.Header, Card.Description, Card.Footer; title, description and body are the text. The footer holds real Button instances, exposed so their props are editable from the Card.

props.name: description
props.default: Team members can view dashboards and comment, but cannot change billing.

props.name: body
props.default: Seats are billed per active member. You currently have 3 of 10 seats in use.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.tsx: A single tick box (Base UI Checkbox inside Field.Item).
checked: false | true (default false; stories set defaultChecked). indeterminate: false | true (default false) — draws the dash and wins over checked. disabled: false | true (default false).
label → Field.Label (text; Field.Label off = no label, name the control with aria-label). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
Glyphs icon/check-checkbox and icon/dash are drawn by the component and are not swappable. Not mirrored: invalid (comes from an enclosing Field.Root), hover border, focus ring — see figma/GAPS.md.

props.name: description
props.default: One email every Monday summarising what changed.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.description:
Contract — src/components/CheckboxGroup/CheckboxGroup.tsx: a labelled group of checkboxes sharing one value array (Base UI CheckboxGroup in Field.Root), as in the Default story.
orientation: vertical | horizontal (default vertical). label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
The options are exposed Checkbox instances; the checked ones' names are the group's defaultValue. Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid state (validation, not a prop).

props.name: description
props.default: You can change this at any time in settings.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: Contract — src/components/Collapsible/Collapsible.tsx: Collapsible.Root > Collapsible.Trigger + Collapsible.Panel, as in the stories at 420px. open: false | true (defaultOpen in the stories) — the panel shows when open. disabled: false | true. panel → Collapsible.Panel (the stories' three-point list). The trigger is an exposed instance.

props.name: panel
props.default:
Runs on every push to a protected branch
Retries transient failures twice before reporting
Artifacts are kept for 30 days

components.name: Collapsible.Trigger
components.description: Contract — src/components/Collapsible/Collapsible.tsx: Collapsible.Trigger. open: false | true — a Collapsible.Root prop (the stories use defaultOpen); turns the chevron 90°. disabled: false | true. showChevron: true by default. children: its text. The chevron (icon/chevron-right-collapsible) is drawn by the component.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Contract — src/components/Combobox/Combobox.tsx: Combobox, a filterable select wired to a label, description and validation message, as in the stories at 320px. label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default). filled, open, disabled, clearable, showTrigger: on the exposed Combobox.Control. Its options are a Combobox.Content of Combobox.Item. Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid border.

props.name: description
props.default: Type to filter the list, then pick a match.

components.name: Combobox.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/Combobox/Combobox.tsx: Combobox.Content — portal, positioner, popup and list — as in the stories: the first countries of the list. Its width is the input's (--anchor-width, runtime; 320px here); it opens below, aligned to the start, 4px away. The options are exposed Combobox.Item instances. Combobox.Empty shows when nothing matches (the NoMatches story).

components.name: Combobox.Control
components.description: Contract — src/components/Combobox/Combobox.tsx: Combobox.Control — the input with its clear and trigger buttons (Base UI InputGroup). filled: false | true — Base UI Field state: the placeholder, or a value. open: false | true — flips the chevron. disabled: false | true. clearable (default true): the clear button, shown on the filled variants. showTrigger (default true): the chevron button. placeholder and value: their texts.

components.name: Combobox.Item
components.description: Contract — src/components/Combobox/Combobox.tsx: Combobox.Item, one option. highlighted: false | true — Base UI state, the option under the pointer or keyboard. selected: false | true — Base UI state, the option equal to the value; draws icon/check and medium weight. disabled: false | true. children: its text.

components.name: Dialog.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/Dialog/Dialog.tsx: Dialog.Content — portal, backdrop and popup, centred on the viewport — as in the Default story. title: text, required (heading-xl). description → Dialog.Description (text). Dialog.Actions: the button row, end-aligned; its Buttons are exposed (Dialog.Close renders them). Width: min(28rem, 100vw − space/8).

props.name: description
props.default: Everyone on the team will be notified.

components.name: Fieldset
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Fieldset/Fieldset.tsx: Fieldset.Root with a Fieldset.Legend, grouping related controls (Base UI Fieldset), as in the Default story at 360px.
disabled: false | true — cascades to every control inside, so the TextFields switch to their own disabled variant too. legend → Fieldset.Legend (text).
The controls are exposed TextField instances; any control can go in a fieldset.

components.name: IconButton
components.description:
Contract — src/components/IconButton/IconButton.tsx: a square, icon-only action on Base UI Button.
variant: ghost | primary | secondary | danger (default ghost). size: md | sm | lg (default md) — 40 / 32 / 48px. disabled: false | true (default false).
children: the icon, an instance swap (icon/edit by default; the stories' icons are the preferred values). label: required — it becomes aria-label; a hidden layer carries it so the frame names the action.

components.name: Menu.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx: Menu.Content — portal, positioner and popup in one piece — as in the Default story. At least 12rem wide; its items are exposed instances. It opens below its trigger, aligned to the start, 6px away (side, align, sideOffset defaults).

components.name: Menu.GroupLabel
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx: Menu.GroupLabel, the heading of a Menu.Group (WithGroups story). children: its text (typography/overline, upper case).

components.name: Menu.Item
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx: Menu.Item, one action. highlighted: false | true — Base UI state, the item under the pointer or keyboard. disabled: false | true. children: its text. Menu.ItemShortcut: off by default (on in the WithGroups story); itemShortcut is its text.

components.name: Menu.Separator
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx: Menu.Separator, a 1px rule between groups of items.

components.name: Menu.SubmenuTrigger
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menu/Menu.tsx: Menu.SubmenuTrigger, an item that opens a nested Menu.Content beside it (WithSubmenu story). open: false | true — the SubmenuRoot's open. children: its text. The chevron (icon/chevron-right) is drawn by the component.

components.name: Menubar
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menubar/Menubar.tsx: Menubar.Root with Menubar.Menu > Menubar.Trigger + Menubar.Content, as in the Default (File, Edit, View) and Vertical (Project, Deploy, 10rem) stories. orientation: horizontal | vertical (default horizontal). The triggers are exposed instances; their menus are Menu.Content.

components.name: Menubar.Trigger
components.description: Contract — src/components/Menubar/Menubar.tsx: Menubar.Trigger, a Menu trigger inside the bar. open: false | true — its Menubar.Menu's open (a Menu.Root prop). disabled: false | true. children: its text. Its menu is a Menu.Content (Menubar.Content).

components.name: Meter
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Meter/Meter.tsx: a static measurement in a known range (Base UI Meter, role="meter"). A reading, not a task — use Progress for tasks.
variant: accent | danger (default accent) — switch to danger past the threshold that matters. size: md | sm (default md).
label → Meter.Label (text). showValue: shows Meter.Value; value is its text ("42%" for value={42}). The indicator is drawn at the stories' 42%.

components.name: NavigationMenu
components.description:
The bar. Root and List hold one Item per Trigger; the Panel is not mirrored.
Contract — src/components/NavigationMenu/NavigationMenu.tsx: NavigationMenu.Root > List > Item > Trigger + Content, then one Panel. The Trigger instances are exposed so their labels are editable here.

components.name: NavigationMenu.Link
components.description:
A destination. Rendered as <a>.
Contract — src/components/NavigationMenu/NavigationMenu.tsx: NavigationMenu.Link, children (the label), href, active (false | true, default false; Base UI renders data-active). Hover is a CSS state.

components.name: NavigationMenu.Trigger
components.description:
Opens the shared panel on hover or click; the chevron is supplied for you.
Contract — src/components/NavigationMenu/NavigationMenu.tsx: NavigationMenu.Trigger, children (the label), disabled. Open and hover are CSS states, not mirrored.

components.name: NumberField
components.description:
Contract — src/components/NumberField/NumberField.tsx: Base UI NumberField in Field.Root — label (also the scrub area), decrement, input, increment, optional description.
disabled: false | true. label: text, required. value: the text in NumberField.Input ("3" for defaultValue={3}). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
The glyphs icon/minus and icon/plus are drawn by the component and not swappable. Not mirrored: the scrub cursor (only while dragging), Field.Error, hover, focus.

props.name: description
props.default: Drag the label sideways to change the value quickly.

components.name: Popover.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/Popover/Popover.tsx: Popover.Content — portal, positioner, popup and arrow. side: top | bottom | left | right (default bottom). title → Popover.Title (text, typography/title-md). description → Popover.Description (text). Both are optional; any other children follow them (the WithActions story adds Buttons).

props.name: description
props.default: Choose how this project reaches you.

components.name: PreviewCard.Content
components.description: Contract — src/components/PreviewCard/PreviewCard.tsx: PreviewCard.Content — portal, positioner, popup and arrow. side: top | bottom | left | right (default bottom). Its children are free content; this is the Default story's profile, drawn from its inline styles. Width is max-content, capped at runtime.

components.name: Progress
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Progress/Progress.tsx: how far along a task is (Base UI Progress). For a reading that is not a task, use Meter.
size: md | sm (default md). status: progressing | complete | indeterminate — Base UI state (ProgressRootState.status), set by value: below max, at max, or null.
label → Progress.Label (text). showValue: shows Progress.Value; value is its text ("40%" for value={40}). The indicator is value as a share of the track, drawn at the stories' 40%.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description:
Contract — src/components/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.tsx: RadioGroup, a set of mutually exclusive options (Base UI RadioGroup in Field.Root), as in the Default story.
orientation: vertical | horizontal (default vertical). label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
The options are exposed RadioGroupItem instances; the checked one's value is the group's defaultValue. Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid state (validation, not a prop).

props.name: description
props.default: Where the next build is published.

components.name: RadioGroupItem
components.description:
Contract — src/components/RadioGroup/RadioGroup.tsx: RadioGroupItem, one option (Base UI Radio in Field.Item).
checked: false | true — Base UI state (RadioRootState.checked): the item whose value equals the group's value/defaultValue. Set it on one item; coming back, its value is the group's defaultValue. disabled: false | true.
label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default).

props.name: description
props.default: Up to ten editors and review.

components.name: Select
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Select/Select.tsx: Select (also Select.Field) — a select wired to a label, description and validation message.
label: text, required. description → Field.Description (text, off by default). placeholder, value, open, disabled: on the exposed Select.Trigger. Its options are a Select.Content of Select.Item — see the open example.
Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid state (validation, not a prop).

props.name: description
props.default: Applies to every document in this workspace.

components.name: Select.Content
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Select/Select.tsx: Select.Content — portal, positioner, popup and list in one piece.
Its width is the trigger's (--anchor-width, computed at runtime; 320px here). Opens below the trigger, aligned to its start, 4px away (side, align, sideOffset defaults).
The options are exposed Select.Item instances. Scroll arrows render only while the list overflows, so they are not drawn.

components.name: Select.GroupLabel
components.description: Contract — src/components/Select/Select.tsx: Select.GroupLabel, the heading of a Select.Group. children: the label text (typography/overline, so it renders upper case).

components.name: Select.Item
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Select/Select.tsx: Select.Item, one option. children: its label.
highlighted: false | true — Base UI state, the option under the pointer or keyboard. selected: false | true — Base UI state, the option equal to the Root value; draws icon/check and medium weight. disabled: false | true (default false), a Select.Item prop.

components.name: Select.Trigger
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Select/Select.tsx: Select.Trigger, the button that opens the popup.
placeholder: true | false — Base UI state (SelectTriggerState.placeholder), true while nothing is selected. value: the text in Select.Value — the placeholder prop while placeholder=true, the selected item's label otherwise.
open: false | true (default false), a Select.Root prop; flips the chevron. disabled: false | true (default false).
The chevron (icon/chevron-down) is drawn by the component and not swappable. Not mirrored: invalid (validation state, not a prop), hover and focus.

components.name: Separator
components.description:
A thin rule between groups. Wraps Base UI’s Separator.
Contract — src/components/Separator/Separator.tsx: orientation (horizontal | vertical, default horizontal). Horizontal is Fill container on the instance; the 1px thickness is raw in the CSS too.

components.name: Slider
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Slider/Slider.tsx: Base UI Slider in Field.Root — label, optional value output, track, optional description.
orientation: horizontal | vertical (default horizontal). disabled: false | true.
label: text, required. showValue: shows Slider.Value; value is its text ("40" for defaultValue={40}). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
The indicator and thumb sit at value as a share of the track (runtime), drawn at the stories' 40. Not mirrored: two thumbs for a range, Field.Error, dragging, hover, focus.

components.name: Spinner
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Spinner/Spinner.tsx: an indeterminate loading indicator (no Base UI primitive; role="status").
size: md | sm | lg (default md) — 24 / 16 / 40px. aria-label: the accessible name, default "Loading"; not drawn.
Colour is currentcolor in code, color/content/accent by default: inside a Button it takes the button's text colour — override both strokes on the instance. Drawn at rest; the spin is not mirrored.

components.name: Switch
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Switch/Switch.tsx: a binary on/off control that takes effect immediately (Base UI Switch in Field.Root).
checked: false | true (the stories use defaultChecked). disabled: false | true.
label → Field.Label (text; off = the bare control). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
Not mirrored: a description without a label, top alignment when a description is present, hover and focus — see figma/GAPS.md.

props.name: description
props.default: Sent to your account address. Digests are never sent more than once a day.

components.name: Table
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Table/Table.tsx: Table.Root — a bordered scroll container, the table and an optional caption — as in the Default story (six invoices, five columns).
striped: false | true (default false). hideCaption: false | true (default false) — the caption stays for screen readers but is not drawn. caption: its text.
Rows are frames of Table.HeaderCell and Table.Cell instances. The last row's missing border and the striped rows are cell overrides (:last-child, :nth-of-type(even)). Column widths come from the default content.

props.name: caption
props.default: Invoices issued in the last quarter

components.name: Table.Cell
components.description: Contract — src/components/Table/Table.tsx: Table.Cell, a <td>. numeric: false | true (default false) — right-aligned, tabular figures. children: its text.

components.name: Table.HeaderCell
components.description: Contract — src/components/Table/Table.tsx: Table.HeaderCell, a <th>. scope: col | row (default col) — col heads a column (bold, strong border, in Table.Head); row heads a body row (medium, as .body .headerCell styles it). numeric: false | true (default false) — right-aligned, tabular figures. children: its text.

components.name: Tabs
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Tabs/Tabs.tsx: Tabs.Root > Tabs.List (Tabs.Tab ×3, Tabs.Indicator) + Tabs.Panel, as in the Default and Vertical stories at 32rem.
orientation: horizontal | vertical (default horizontal), a Tabs.Root prop. panel → Tabs.Panel (text).
The tabs are exposed Tabs.Tab instances: edit their children, set active on exactly one — its value is the Root's defaultValue.

props.name: panel
props.default: A summary of the project, its owners and the current release.

components.name: Tabs.Tab
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Tabs/Tabs.tsx: Tabs.Tab, one tab button (Base UI Tabs.Tab).
disabled: false | true (default false). children: the tab label. orientation: horizontal | vertical, set on Tabs.Root and inherited.
active: true for the tab whose value equals Tabs.Root value/defaultValue (Base UI data-active). Set it on exactly one tab; coming back, that tab's value becomes the Root's defaultValue.
Tabs.Indicator: the Base UI part that marks the active tab. Base UI sizes and moves it at runtime (--active-tab-*); it is drawn where that lands, inside the active tab.

components.name: TextField
components.description:
Contract — src/components/TextField/TextField.tsx: A single-line input with a label, optional description and validation message, wired by Base UI Field so the input gets its accessible name and description from the primitive.
filled: false | true — Base UI Field state, true once there is a value. disabled: false | true.
label: text, required. placeholder: text shown while empty. value: text shown when filled (the defaultValue). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid border (validation, not a prop), hover, focus.

props.name: description
props.default: We only use this to send receipts.

components.name: Textarea
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Textarea/Textarea.tsx: A multi-line input with a label, optional description and validation message, wired by Base UI Field.
filled: false | true — Base UI Field state, true once there is a value. disabled: false | true.
label: text, required. placeholder: text shown while empty. value: text shown when filled (the defaultValue). description → Field.Description (text, off by default).
Not mirrored: Field.Error and the invalid border (validation, not a prop), hover, focus. rows (default 4) sets the height: four body-md lines here; resize the control on an instance for more. The resize grip is the browser's, so resize=vertical|none is not drawn.

props.name: value
props.default:
Fixed a crash when opening a project with no members.
Speeded up the first paint by roughly 200ms.

props.name: description
props.default: Markdown is supported. Keep it under 500 characters.

components.name: Toast.Root
components.description: Contract — src/components/Toast/Toast.tsx: Toast.Root, one notification, as Toast.useToastManager().add() renders it. type: none | success | error — the toast's type option (none = not given); success and error colour the border. title → Toast.Title. description → Toast.Description. action → Toast.Action's text, from actionProps (off unless given). The close button (icon/close, aria-label "Close notification") is drawn by the component.

props.name: description
props.default: Build #482 starts as soon as a runner frees up.

components.name: Toggle
components.description:
Contract — src/components/Toggle/Toggle.tsx: a button that stays pressed (Base UI Toggle). Wrap several in ToggleGroup for a set.
variant: secondary | ghost (default secondary). size: md | sm | lg (default md). pressed: false | true (a Base UI prop; the stories use defaultPressed). disabled: false | true. iconOnly: false | true (default false) squares it off.
children: the label text. With iconOnly, the icon — swap the nested icon layer (icon/bold by default). aria-label: the name an icon-only toggle needs; a hidden layer carries it.
Not mirrored: an icon beside a label (WithIcon story), hover.

components.name: ToggleGroup
components.description:
Contract — src/components/ToggleGroup/ToggleGroup.tsx: a set of Toggles sharing one value (Base UI ToggleGroup), as in the Default story (List pressed).
segmented: false | true (default false) — one joined track, the pressed segment lifted onto the surface. orientation: horizontal | vertical. disabled: false | true, cascading to each Toggle.
The options are exposed Toggle instances; the pressed ones' values are the group's defaultValue. In segmented groups the group restyles its Toggles (.segmented > button): here that look is an override on each instance — see figma/GAPS.md before moving the selection.

components.name: Toolbar
components.description: Contract — src/components/Toolbar/Toolbar.tsx: Toolbar.Root with Toolbar.Group, Toolbar.Button, Toolbar.Separator and Toolbar.Link, as in the Grouped story. orientation: horizontal | vertical (default horizontal). The buttons and the link are exposed instances.

components.name: Toolbar.Button
components.description: Contract — src/components/Toolbar/Toolbar.tsx: Toolbar.Button. disabled: false | true. children: an icon (icon/bold here — swap the icon layer) or text (show the children layer, hide the icon). aria-label: the name an icon button needs; a hidden layer carries it. The pressed / open tint applies only when it renders a Toggle or a Menu trigger — see figma/GAPS.md.

components.name: Toolbar.Input
components.description: Contract — src/components/Toolbar/Toolbar.tsx: Toolbar.Input, an input in the toolbar's roving tab stop (WithInput story). disabled: false | true. placeholder: its text.

components.name: Toolbar.Link
components.description: Contract — src/components/Toolbar/Toolbar.tsx: Toolbar.Link, a link inside the toolbar's roving tab stop. children: its text. Underlined on hover (a CSS state).

components.name: Toolbar.Separator
